status: RECORDED REGRESSION BASELINE — what the two implementations agreed on at capture; it says nothing about whether either is right
warning: These record what the reference engine computed at the captured commit so that future drift is caught. Do not cite them as accuracy reference data; see docs/VALIDATION.md.

documentation.purpose: The recorded regression baseline for `scripts/parity/run.mjs --reference frozen`: the engine under test (native or wasm) must reproduce every entry inside its recorded tolerance, with no JavaScript reference present. This is a drift check, not a statement about the physics: a disagreement is a finding to report, and this file is corrected only with a cited external source (a published CTI/MRL figure or equivalent), never to make a port or a fix pass.
documentation.regenerate: the recorded baseline can no longer be re-recorded: it holds the values the JavaScript reference produced at capture, and that reference was deleted in issue #40 slice 4 (the last commit that contains it is recorded in the private decision record D17). It is frozen evidence -- a value moves only with a cited external correction, in the same commit as the citation.
documentation.check: node scripts/parity/run.mjs --reference frozen   # replays this file against the native binary
documentation.rule: pass when |delta| <= tolerance.abs OR |delta| / |baseline| <= tolerance.rel, the same rule (and the same per-quantity tolerances) the live comparison uses
documentation.entryFormat: kind number|text|nullish: `value` is the recorded value (nullish spells "null" or "undefined"); kind series: `value` is the whole recorded JavaScript ordinate series and every point is diffed with the same tolerance (the row displays the pair that uses up the most of it); kind refusal: the reference refused and `refusal` records the status and error kind the engine used; kind skip: the reference itself decided there was nothing to compare. `extract` re-reads the engine's own value from its reply: `path` (dotted, `[i]` indexed, `[]` takes the entry's index), `string-of`, `length`, `length-text`, `join`, `keys-join`, `nozzle-options`, `series` (the same ordinates, one per curve point), `candidate-field`/`candidate-metrics`/`candidate-nozzle` (a selection candidate found by identity), `identity-match`/`identity-missing`. `predicate` entries re-run a reply-only invariant (`documented-order`, `margin-floor`, `candidate-parity`, `ordering-difference`) instead of diffing one value.
documentation.whatIsNotHere: The comparison once also diffed the wasm binding's data-only surface (a JavaScript surface with no engine reply behind it) and the reference's own refusals; those rows have no recorded counterpart. The harness now runs one leg -- this file -- so its output names the wasm binding section as NOT COMPARED rather than skipping it quietly.
